feature: FTR-018 US-09-TASK-TEST-02 real-runtime smoke test (throwaway single-task fixture, not this repo)

authorization.note: replacement cap after cycle-7 attempt 1 overshoot finding; not cumulative

outcome: PARTIAL - real dispatch chain exercised twice against the real Claude runtime; neither attempt completed the (deliberately trivial) task within its authorized per-call budget flag. Closed as partial evidence per explicit user decision, no further real calls made.
findings: The runtime bridge (Percorso C: Node coordinator -> spawnClaudeAgent -> real claude.exe subprocess) works end-to-end: real process spawn, real --agent resolution to gaia-developer-backend, real stdin prompt delivery, real structured JSON result capture, real is_error/terminal_reason/cost fields all present and correctly parsed by claude-process.js/dispatchTaskAttempt.

--max-budget-usd does NOT hard-stop spend exactly at the flag value: attempt 1 overshot by roughly 2.3x ($0.039 absolute overshoot on a $0.03 flag); attempt 2 overshot by a much smaller absolute amount (~$0.006 on a $0.08 flag). The mechanism appears to check budget between turns, not preemptively mid-turn, and a single expensive turn (large cache-creation cost) can push spend past the flag before the check fires.

gaia-developer-backend pays a large, repeated cache-creation cost (~26-27k tokens, most of the real spend) on every fresh session, largely independent of task triviality - a realistic per-dispatch cost floor for this specific agent is well above the $0.03-0.08 flags tested here, even for a one-file task.

Neither attempt reached tool execution far enough to write the target file; verification/review/checkpoint stages of the real chain were consequently never reached in this run - this evidence covers real dispatch/spawn/budget-handling behavior, not a full real checkpoint-to-commit cycle.

Ledger integrity held throughout: each real attempt's own ledger entry (opened by dispatchTaskAttempt before spawn, per this feature's own persist-before-invoke discipline) recorded real observed cost/duration, never a fabricated or default value.
